target: LOI (%), RPUF literature benchmark of record: 460 rows / 83 papers
declared: by Opus 5.5, see git commit time; before any run
authority: blockers/resolved/DECISION-20261003-1431-loi-freeze-lifted.md (human lifted the freeze for LOI; 2 extra rounds)

incumbent.config: exp085 config (RF n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, NaN-native; round-1 features + PubChem el_* + RDKit structure features)

new_features.F6_base_foam: polyol_type one-hot {polyether, polyester_aromatic, bio_based, unknown} by regex on the row's polyol text (polyether|PET-4110|LY-4110|Voranol|Rokopol|4110 -> polyether; polyester|Stepanpol|PS-?2352|Isoexter|aromatic -> polyester_aromatic; soy|rapeseed|castor|tung|palm|lignin|canola|bio|HSBP|sucrose-free vegetable -> bio_based; first match in order bio, polyester, polyether); iso_index_num (ratio: values > 10 divided by 100; NaN if missing); is_PIR = iso_index_num >= 1.8 OR /PIR|isocyanurate/ in polyol/isocyanate/notes text
new_features.F7_element_fill: el_* NaN filled from class priors: for each FR class, the median element mass fraction over FR mentions in the dataset whose names resolve in fr_element_table.csv or fr_structures.csv (computed from the element/structure tables only, never from LOI); loading-weighted as in build_loi_rpuf.py; flag el_imputed_share

candidates.desc: equal-weight average of c2-RF and HistGradientBoosting(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0) on c2 features, per fold

protocols: identical to the record: B = GroupKFold by paper 5x10, paper-bootstrap CI on repeat 0 + pooled CI; A random 80/20 x50 (theirs); C by dominant FR class
selection_rule: highest B mean; adopt over exp087 only if >= 8/10 paired B repeats better AND B ci_lo >= 0.146; then critic before the record changes
reported_not_selectable: 'baseline-aware' variant: c2 + the paper's own neat-control LOI as an input (a different task: predicting LOI given the base foam's LOI; never compared with Sun/Fu)
exit_triggers: B ci_lo > 0.84 or A mean > 0.84 -> EXIT 5
round5: only if round 4 adopts something and time remains before 16:15; declared separately
